examples.ko: 커피를 사 오는 그사이에 비가 그쳤어요.
examples.en: The rain stopped in the meantime while I went to buy coffee.
It's been a while. You've really changed a lot in the meantime.

examples.ko: 바쁜 그사이에도 가족 생각을 놓지 않았어요.
examples.en: Even in that busy time, I never stopped thinking of my family.

examples.ko: 회의가 시작되기 전 그사이를 이용해 숙제를 끝냈어요.
examples.en: I used the time before the meeting started to finish my homework.
There was not a single contact in the meantime.

examples.ko: 일이 끝나고 저녁 먹기 전 그사이가 제일 편해요.
examples.en: The gap between finishing work and eating dinner is the most relaxing.

explain: '그동안'은 쭉 이어진 기간을 말하고, '그사이'는 두 일 사이의 틈을 가리켜요. 그래서 '잠깐 자리를 비운 그사이'처럼 짧은 틈에 일어난 일을 말할 때 잘 어울려요. '그 사이'처럼 띄어 쓰기도 해요.
explain_en: '그동안' refers to a continuous period, while '그사이' points to the gap between two events. So it suits things that happen in a short gap, as in '잠깐 자리를 비운 그사이' (while I stepped away for a moment). You will also see it written as '그 사이'.

en: all the time; every single day

examples.en: My younger brother does nothing but play games every day.

examples.ko: 맨날 늦는 친구 때문에 화가 났어요.
examples.en: I got angry at a friend who is late all the time.

examples.ko: 요즘 맨날 비가 와서 빨래가 안 말라요.
examples.en: It rains every day lately, so the laundry won't dry.

examples.ko: 맨날 라면만 먹으면 건강에 안 좋아요.
examples.en: Eating only ramen every day isn't good for your health.

examples.ko: 우리는 어릴 때 맨날 같이 놀았어요.
examples.en: We played together every day when we were little.
After work I watch dramas at home every day.

explain: '매일'과 비슷하지만 '똑같은 일이 계속 반복돼서 지겹다'는 느낌이 섞여 불평할 때 많이 써요. 뉴스·발표·글에서는 '매일'이나 '늘'을 쓰고, 말할 때 '맨날'이 더 흔해요.
explain_en: Close to '매일' but it often carries a 'the same thing again and again, how tiresome' feel, so it is common in complaints. In news, presentations and writing use '매일' or '늘'; in speech '맨날' is more common.

examples.en: On warm spring days I take a walk in the park with my family.
Today is a really nice spring day with great weather.

examples.ko: 어느 봄날 아침에 그 친구를 만났어요.
examples.en: I met that friend one spring morning.
The soft spring sunlight comes in through the window.

examples.ko: 저는 꽃이 피는 봄날이 제일 좋아요.
examples.en: I like spring days when flowers bloom best.
I want to become a warm person like a spring day.

explain: '봄'은 계절 전체이고 봄날은 봄 중의 하루나 봄 같은 날씨를 말해요. 노래나 시에 자주 나와서 좋았던 시절을 '화양연화'나 '봄날'로 비유하기도 해요. 겨울에도 따뜻하면 '봄날 같다'고 말해요.
explain_en: 봄 is the whole season, while 봄날 is a single day in spring or a springlike day. It often appears in songs and poems, and 봄날 can also stand for the good days of one's life. A warm winter day can be called 봄날 같다.

examples.en: I left this neighborhood a long time ago.

examples.ko: 한국에서는 집에 들어갈 때 신발을 벗는 풍습이 오래전부터 있었어요.
examples.en: In Korea, the custom of taking off shoes when entering a home has existed since long ago.
It was so long ago that I can't remember the name.
It was long ago, but it's still vivid.
I reread a novel I had read long ago.
I took an old photo out of the album and looked at it.

explain: 한 단어이므로 '오래전'처럼 붙여 쓰고, 조사는 '오래전에, 오래전부터, 오래전의'로 이어져요. '옛날'은 훨씬 먼 과거나 이야기 속 시대에 어울리고, '오래전'은 몇 년이나 몇십 년 전처럼 내가 아는 과거에 써요. 반대로 가까운 과거는 '얼마 전', '최근'이라고 해요.
explain_en: It is written as one word, '오래전', and takes particles as in '오래전에', '오래전부터' and '오래전의'. '옛날' suits a much farther past or storybook times, while '오래전' fits a past you personally know, such as years or decades ago. The recent past is '얼마 전' or '최근'.

examples.en: In my first year at the company, I made a lot of mistakes.
The first year abroad was the hardest.

examples.ko: 결혼 첫해에 우리는 작은 집에서 살았어요.
examples.en: In our first year of marriage, we lived in a small house.
I still remember the experiences of the first year.

examples.ko: 가게를 열고 첫해에 손님이 많지 않았어요.
examples.en: In the first year after opening the shop, there weren't many customers.

examples.ko: 아이가 태어난 첫해는 정말 정신없이 지나갔어요.
examples.en: The first year after the baby was born flew by in a blur.

explain: '첫해'는 한 단어라서 붙여 써요. 그다음 해는 '이듬해'나 '둘째 해'라고 해요. '첫날, 첫눈, 첫사랑'처럼 '첫-'이 붙은 말이 많아요.
explain_en: 첫해 is one word, written without a space. The year after it is 이듬해 or 둘째 해. Many words start with 첫-, such as 첫날, 첫눈 and 첫사랑.
